notes:
Balance book 0.3.8 protects unsaved changes and adds reminder-time settings.

- Edited dialogs ask before discarding changes. Save becomes available after a change and disables again if you undo it.
- Pick the local time for all child-support reminders, with 9 a.m. as the default.
- Backup time and weekday are side by side.
- App update checks are manual in Settings > About.
- Cleaner Balance and Settings screens, with more space around History and navigation buttons.

Install over your existing app to keep your saved ledger. Android 8 or newer.
